title: Copay Card Use at Retail Pharmacies and the Specialty Pharmacy Program Card Benefit
content:
A manufacturer copay card can also be used at a retail pharmacy. Under the member's **Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit**, a network pharmacy bills the member's payment on a retail claim to the manufacturer copay card as secondary payer, after Northbridge Rx. That use reduces the card benefit available to the member's Specialty Pharmacy Program enrollment for the same drug.

**Rule.** Card use at a retail pharmacy is the member's payment recorded on a paid retail claim for the same drug.

- When a benefit load is on the enrollment's ledger, and paid retail claims for the drug are dated fewer whole months before today than the first day of the load's program year, the card use on those claims is taken off the benefit.
- When no load is on the ledger, and paid retail claims for the drug fall in the last 12 months, the card use on those claims is taken off the assistance balance shown on the enrollment.
- Otherwise no card use at retail pharmacies is taken off.

**Terms.**

- **Records read.** The retail records are the member's paid claims under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit. Each such claim is for the same drug as the specialty enrollment's therapy drug, and is dated by its date of service. The card use is the member-paid amount recorded on each claim.
- **Program year.** The load's program year runs from January 1 to December 31 of the year named on the latest benefit load.
- **Last 12 months.** This means fewer than 12 whole months before today.
- **Whole months.** The number of whole months between a date and today is the count of calendar months from that date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than that date's day of the month.

## Ladder

| Benefit load on the ledger | Paid retail claims for the drug in the applicable window | Retail card use taken off |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes, dated fewer whole months before today than January 1 of the load's program year | the member's payments recorded on those claims, taken off the benefit |
| No | Yes, within the last 12 months | the member's payments recorded on those claims, taken off the assistance balance shown on the enrollment |
| Yes or No | None in the applicable window | zero |

## Cases (assumed: today is 2026-10-08)

- *A load for program year 2026 is on the ledger.* January 1, 2026 lies 9 whole months before today. Assume paid retail claims for the drug dated 2026-03-12, with $35.00 member paid, and 2026-08-03, with $35.00 member paid. Both lie fewer than 9 whole months before today, so retail card use is $70.00.
- *Same load, and the only paid retail claim for the drug is dated 2025-11-20.* That claim lies 10 whole months before today, which is not fewer than 9, so retail card use is zero.
- *No load is on the ledger, and one paid retail claim for the drug is dated 2025-11-20 with $50.00 member paid.* It lies fewer than 12 whole months before today, so $50.00 is taken off the assistance balance shown.
- *Paid retail claims exist only for a different drug.* Retail card use is zero.
